card: Drill into a row and back: the table forgets filter, sort and where you were

apps/console/src/ui/tableView.test.tsx::keeps two tables with the same label apart by viewKey
apps/console/src/ui/tableView.test.tsx::falls back when what it remembered is gone: column, facet option, row
apps/console/src/ui/tableView.test.tsx::'Clear filter' forgets the remembered query and facet, and keeps the sort
apps/console/src/ui/tableView.test.tsx::without a viewKey nothing is remembered (guard: today's behaviour)

case 5 no viewKey = today (plus every existing ui.test.tsx FilterTable case unchanged)

deviations_from_card: Tests and the primitive landed in one commit (tests pass the viewKey prop, which does not typecheck before it exists); they were run red first (4 of 6 tests red, by assertion). Clear-filter case extended to also assert sort survives Clear, which makes it red before. tableView exposes get/set/clear/reset; FilterTable uses get/set only. Returned-row accent is a 1.2s background fade (no movement, so no reduced-motion block), kept minimal for CSS budgets. Per-identity keys: characters.<id>.situations and simulator.tournaments.<id>.runs.
